english: Out-harvest your enemies with Fruit Punch Mega Crush! It's got electrolytes and fuels you with fire!
All forms of harvesting are increased by 50%. Stamina is regenerating.
Become one with a kangaroo and hop over your enemies with Grape Mega Crush! It's got electrolytes and strange particles floating in it!
Jump height increased by 3 blocks. Stamina is regenerating.
Out-loot your enemies with Green Apple Mega Crush! It's got electrolytes, and makes your eyes emit radiation!
Loot stage is increased by 10 and then by 10%. Looting and lockpicking speeds increased by 50%. Stamina is regenerating.
Years ago the snowberry was used as a painkiller along with other plants. Now that the apocalypse has come it is a very precious resource.
Herbal Painkillers help you shrug off stunning blows and give you a quick boost of health. Like all chems they make you little thirsty. Unlocked by craftingMedical level 10.
You took painkillers. Stuns will affect you less now.
Twice-baked cornmeal ration bread. It keeps forever and tastes like it. It has no smell, so it's safe to eat on a run, but you'll want water with it.
Plain strips of meat dried over a coal fire. It carries well and hardly smells, but it's salty.
Cornmeal dough fried in animal fat. Cheap, filling and easy to make in the first days.
One egg in hot fat. The smallest real meal there is.
Three eggs folded around wild mushrooms.
Diner breakfast: cornmeal biscuits under thick meat gravy. It sits heavy and keeps you going.
Skillet potatoes, corn and meat, the kind of breakfast that gets a long day started.
Cake with real coffee in it. A small lift and a reminder of better days.
Finally a use for all those bones. Boiled for hours, it's good for the sick and the hurt.
Pumpkin boiled down with fat and water until it's smooth.
Two cans and a pot of water. It tastes like before.
A Southwest staple: meat in cornmeal dough, tied up in yucca and steamed.
Canned chili stretched with real meat and corn. Hot enough to warm you, and you'll want a drink after.
Two cans in one pot. It tastes better than it should.
Tart cold-country berries under a corn crust.
Desert fruit pie with a sharp, sweet filling.
A savory pie of wild mushrooms.
The big one: three kinds of meat in one crust.
Eaten straight from the jar. The sugar gives you a small lift.
Real survival tea, full of vitamin C, brewed from the seeds and needles of mountain pine.
Roasted acorns stretching your last coffee beans. Weaker than the real thing.
Cool and bitter. Good on a desert day.
Homemade fizz. The sugar gives you a small lift.
Homemade spirit. It warms you up and makes the room lean a little.
Brewed like beer, with pumpkin in the mash.

For 15 seconds you take no damage at all. When it ends, half of everything you absorbed lands at once, and that can kill you.\n\nEnds in a Crash. Taking another chem during a Crash is an Overdose.

The whole world slows down for 8 seconds. You slow too, but your aim doesn't. In co-op, where the world can't slow, it gives you speed instead.\n\nEnds in a Crash. Taking another chem during a Crash is an Overdose.
